sources.title: Fun-ASR-Nano-2512: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Fun-ASR-Nano-2512 is an end-to-end speech recognition model built by FunAudioLLM that converts speech to text across 31 languages with 800M parameters. The model trains on tens of millions of hours of real speech data and supports low-latency real-time transcription.
